gen-gf-princess-sofia-general-sans: Loose, handwritten charm leads in Princess Sofia, its lowercase deep in the middle and its letters nearly touching, while General Sans follows in sans-serif. It stays easy over a full page.
gen-gf-princess-sofia-manrope: Manrope sets bright, open curves and a single line width under Princess Sofia's casual handwriting, with its lowercase pushed together tight. Hand against ruler is the draw.
gen-gf-princess-sofia-montserrat: Princess Sofia's lowercase sits deep in the middle, hand-drawn and nearly touching from letter to letter. And Montserrat runs on beneath it, a sans line traced as if with one marker, gliding smoothly down a page.
gen-gf-princess-sofia-satoshi: Graceful and a little casual, Princess Sofia leans on its deep lowercase and tight spacing, while Satoshi's plain sans lines stay one width throughout. Loose hand against steady line is what stands out.
gen-gf-princess-sofia-switzer: Switzer reads like fine wire, with tubular letters, a high waist and tips that never close in on themselves. And Princess Sofia earns its place when set big and brief, its handwriting loose.
gen-gf-princess-sofia-work-sans: Princess Sofia has a deep lowercase belly and almost no gap between letters. Work Sans backs it with a smooth, drawn-wire plain sans line, so the hand-drawn heading and the modern body sit together easily.
gen-gf-prosto-one-fs-karma: Karma reads in a trustworthy, classic serif, its modulation gentle enough that nothing snags the eye as lines go by. Prosto One makes statements; Karma does the patient talking.
gen-gf-prosto-one-fs-paquito: Tall, wide and commanding up top, then something warmer below. Prosto One carries a faint crayon-like rhythm in its bowls, but Paquito is the one that settles in as a text serif, confident and approachable.
gen-gf-protest-guerrilla-fs-paquito: Paquito reads as a confident, approachable serif, with capitals that sit close to the lowercase height. Over a long passage, Paquito keeps a friendly, steady pace beneath Protest Guerrilla's loud, soaring letters.
gen-gf-protest-revolution-fs-paquito: Protest Revolution brings diagonals a touch lighter than its verticals and big open counters in every small letter. But Paquito settles into a friendly serif rhythm that would carry a longer passage without effort.
